experiment_data.hypothesis: SS training on LoRA-only checkpoint (no ThreadGate) with same hyperparameters (rho_max=0.3, same schedule) should achieve similar GAR improvement as SS+TG. If confirmed, this proves the SS fix is architecture-agnostic, strengthening the paper's mitigation story (the gap is caused by exposure bias in any auxiliary-loss setup, and SS fixes it regardless of gating mechanism).

spec.notes: SS+LoRA-only (gate_type=none, ss_max_ratio=0.3). From-scratch training, not resume. Auto TF+AR eval after training. ~6.5h training + eval.
